title: OmnibusCloud job document vocabulary: render
description: Published document types of one controller component. Each $defs entry keyed by a type id (<component>.<name>@<major>) is the value shape carried by a job request parameter of kind "document" and by the value document of a job variable; each entry keyed by a plain name is an enum referenced by those shapes. Wire convention: camelCase properties, enum member names as strings, null properties omitted.

render.bakeOptions@1.title: RenderBakeOptions
render.bakeOptions@1.description: Options for a host-delegated simulation bake (Render.BakeSimulation). The bake runs once on a single node selected by Grid.Delegate (the fastest compatible node, by the same render-throughput benchmark used for distribution), converting an unbaked sequential simulation into a per-frame, frame-addressable OpenVDB cache that is then sliced and rendered distributed.

simulationKinds.description: Comma-separated simulation kinds to bake. v1 honours "Fluid" (Mantaflow gas/liquid domains). Other kinds (Cloth, Particles, …) reuse the same delegate-bake framework in later iterations.

cacheFormat.description: Cache format for the baked sequence. v1 produces "OpenVDB" (per-frame, frame-addressable).

resolutionMax.description: Optional override for the fluid domain resolution (resolution_max). 0 keeps the scene's value. Lets a submitter cap network bake cost / cache size without editing the scene.

render.options@1.title: RenderOptions
render.options@1.description: Rendering parameters: format, engine, and quality settings. Shared between SDK, controller, and plugins.

denoise.description: Apply denoising to the rendered image.

batchSize.description: Persistent-batch chunk size: how many frames/tiles Render.SplitBatched groups into one chunk (each chunk renders in a single Blender process). 0 = use the per-engine default (Render.Split derives it from Engine). Declared last so the wire format stays backward compatible — callers (plugin/SDK) that don't set it deserialize to 0 and get the default.

colorMode.description: Output colour channels. Default reproduces legacy behaviour (RGB for PNG/JPEG, scene default for EXR). Declared after BatchSize so the wire format stays backward compatible — old callers deserialize to Default and render as before.

filmTransparent.description: Whether the film/world background is rendered transparent. Default leaves the scene's own setting untouched. Appended for wire back-compat.

colorDepth.description: Output bit depth. Default leaves the scene/format default untouched. Appended for wire back-compat.

render.preflight@1.title: RenderPreflight
render.preflight@1.description: Unified preflight validation result across the currently supported render modes.

runtimeDiagnostics.description: Packaged runtime diagnostics used to evaluate the preflight request.

still.description: Single-frame still preflight result, evaluated as a one-frame specialization of frame rendering.

canRenderAll.description: Whether all currently evaluated render modes are ready on the current packaged runtime.

render.preflightFrames@1.title: RenderPreflightFrames
render.preflightFrames@1.description: Preflight validation result for frame-based rendering on the current packaged runtime.

canRender.description: Whether the current packaged runtime can execute the requested frame render.

runtimeTarget.description: Runtime target resolved for the current process, such as windows-x64.

issues.description: Human-readable preflight issues that block the requested frame render.

warnings.description: Human-readable preflight warnings that do not block the requested frame render.

render.preflightStillTiled@1.title: RenderPreflightStillTiled
render.preflightStillTiled@1.description: Preflight validation result for tiled still rendering on the current packaged runtime.

canRender.description: Whether the current packaged runtime can execute the requested tiled still render.

runtimeTarget.description: Runtime target resolved for the current process, such as windows-x64.

requestedBlendMode.description: Requested tile blend mode for the preflight validation.

issues.description: Human-readable preflight issues that block the requested tiled render.

warnings.description: Human-readable preflight warnings that do not block the requested tiled render.

render.preflightVideo@1.title: RenderPreflightVideo
render.preflightVideo@1.description: Preflight validation result for video rendering on the current packaged runtime.

canRender.description: Whether the current packaged runtime can execute the requested video render.

runtimeTarget.description: Runtime target resolved for the current process, such as windows-x64.

issues.description: Human-readable preflight issues that block the requested video render.

warnings.description: Human-readable preflight warnings that do not block the requested video render.

render.runtimeDiagnostics@1.title: RenderRuntimeDiagnostics
render.runtimeDiagnostics@1.description: Runtime diagnostics for the packaged render controller tools available on the current node.

runtimeTarget.description: Runtime target resolved for the current process, such as windows-x64.

blenderAvailable.description: Whether the packaged Blender runtime is available.

availableRenderBackends.description: Render backends detected as available for automatic local selection.

selectedRenderBackend.description: Backend currently selected by the node for automatic rendering.

usesGpuForRendering.description: Whether automatic local selection resolved to a GPU backend.

ffmpegAvailable.description: Whether the packaged ffmpeg runtime is available.

ffprobeAvailable.description: Whether the packaged ffprobe runtime is available.

supportsCenterPriorityCrop.description: Whether tiled center-priority crop stitching is supported.

supportsAlphaBlend.description: Whether tiled alpha-blend stitching is supported.

render.sceneAttachmentRef@1.title: RenderSceneAttachmentRef
render.sceneAttachmentRef@1.description: Metadata about one addon-side dependency artifact associated with a scene reference.

kind.description: Logical dependency kind, for example ImageAsset or Font.

blobId.description: Cloud blob identifier of the uploaded dependency artifact when it is transferred separately from the blend file.

originalPath.description: Original addon-side source path observed in the Blender scene.

relativePath.description: Logical relative path or slot name inside the addon-side scene package.

packagingStrategy.description: Packaging strategy attempted by the addon for this dependency.

frame.description: Frame this artifact belongs to, for per-frame baked simulation caches (one cache file per frame). null = applies to all frames (textures, linked libraries, and other non-frame-specific deps). Lets Render.Split* send each render node only the cache files for the frames it renders. Appended last for MemoryPack wire back-compatibility.

render.sceneRef@1.title: RenderSceneRef
render.sceneRef@1.description: Bootstrap blob-backed typed-scene reference for host-side BuildBlendFromRefs execution. Current implementation points directly at a prepared .blend blob in storage.

blendBlobId.description: Blob identifier of a prepared .blend payload.

attachedFiles.description: Addon-side metadata about dependency artifacts associated with the referenced scene payload.

render.tileOptions@1.title: RenderTileOptions
render.tileOptions@1.description: Tile-specific options for tiled still rendering. Kept separate from RenderOptionsData because different scripts may need different tiling inputs.

overlapPx.description: Tile overlap in pixels. Current tiled slice uses center-priority crop when overlap is greater than zero.

render.validateBlend@1.title: RenderValidateBlend
render.validateBlend@1.description: Validation result for one uploaded .blend scene.

isValid.description: Whether the scene is currently considered portable and valid for the supported remote render flow.

issues.description: Validation issues that block the current remote render flow.

warnings.description: Validation findings that do not currently block the remote render flow but may require user attention.

render.videoOptions@1.title: RenderVideoOptions
render.videoOptions@1.description: Video encoding options for the first production RenderVideo path. Current scope is intentionally minimal: MP4 container with H.264 video and no audio.

frameRate.description: Output frame rate in frames per second.

constantRateFactor.description: CRF quality setting passed to the ffmpeg encoder (libx264/libx265/libvpx-vp9). Lower values mean higher quality and larger output.

format.description: Container + codec preset. APPENDED after ConstantRateFactor (wire order is append-only); Default keeps the legacy MP4/H.264 behaviour for old payloads.

RenderColorDepth.title: RenderColorDepth
RenderColorDepth.description: Output bit depth per channel (Blender's image_settings.color_depth).

x-oc-member-descriptions.Default: Leave the scene/format default untouched (legacy behaviour).

RenderColorMode.title: RenderColorMode
RenderColorMode.description: Output colour channels for a render.

x-oc-member-descriptions.Default: Legacy behaviour: force RGB for PNG/JPEG, leave the scene default for EXR. Keeps old clients (which don't send a colour mode) rendering exactly as before.
x-oc-member-descriptions.RGBA: RGBA (with alpha) — needed for transparent renders / compositing.

RenderFilmTransparency.title: RenderFilmTransparency
RenderFilmTransparency.description: Whether the film/world background is rendered transparent (Blender's render.film_transparent).

x-oc-member-descriptions.Default: Leave the scene's own film-transparent setting untouched (legacy behaviour).
x-oc-member-descriptions.Transparent: Force a transparent background (combine with RGBA for transparent output).

RenderFormat.title: RenderFormat
RenderFormat.description: Output image format for rendering. APPEND-ONLY: values travel as MemoryPack ints — never reorder or remove members.

TileBlendMode.title: TileBlendMode
TileBlendMode.description: Stitching mode for tiled still rendering.

x-oc-member-descriptions.CenterPriorityCrop: Crop each rendered tile back to its logical core area before overlay.
x-oc-member-descriptions.AlphaBlend: Blend overlap regions with linear feathering and normalized weight accumulation.

VideoFormat.title: VideoFormat
VideoFormat.description: Video container + codec PRESET for the RenderVideo path. A single preset enum (instead of two independent container/codec axes) keeps invalid combinations unrepresentable on the wire. Default = the legacy behaviour (MP4/H.264), so payloads from older clients that do not send the field are encoded exactly as before. APPEND-ONLY: values travel as MemoryPack ints — never reorder or remove members.

x-oc-member-descriptions.MovProres422Hq: QuickTime ProRes 422 HQ — the editing/grading intermediate standard. Quality is fixed by the ProRes profile; ConstantRateFactor is ignored.
x-oc-member-descriptions.MovProres4444: QuickTime ProRes 4444 — carries an ALPHA channel (transparent video for overlays) when the rendered frames have one (RGBA + transparent film). CRF is ignored.
